plan.rationale: Control-only research is legitimate and joint acceptance was already recorded as attainable on this same T0 template by speed-weight adaptation, so the outstanding uncertainty is the location of the acceptance band, not whether structure permits it. The 0.05 source fails only on held tip speed while every other objective and constraint passes, and terminal_tip_speed_weight is already at its 0.1 upper bound, so the single admissible lever is a decrease of holding_tip_speed_weight. With exactly one development execution left (development_used 5 of 6) and one executable backend solve available, a model-authored explicit enumeration of a single informative point at 0.04375 is the least ambiguous way to spend it: it lies between the recorded pass near 0.0375 and the 0.05 near-miss, is a new configuration (no replication), and cannot be confused with a numerical method's own proposal ordering.
